title: PeachPDF CSS/SVG property registry
description: Schema for css-properties.json, consumed by PeachPDF.SourceGenerators to emit CssPropertyRegistry.g.cs / SvgPropertyRegistry.g.cs. See CLAUDE.md's generator section for the full authoring guide and the PPGxxx diagnostics that enforce this shape at build time.

inherited.description: CSS 2.1 §6.2 inheritance. Drives the generated InheritedProperties set.

initialValue.description: A string literal, an {expression} spliced verbatim as C# (for a runtime/platform-computed default like CssConstants.DefaultFont), or null to declare 'no initial value, by design' (a logical scratch field, or a genuinely unimplemented property). The key must always be present — PPG006 fires if it's missing entirely.

category.description: "logical" marks one of the 24 CSS Logical Properties scratch fields (see CssBox.LogicalProperties.cs) — requires initialValue: null and permits resolvesTo.

cssDataType.description: A single data type, or an array (union — any member matching accepts the value). See the type list below; object forms carry extra fields.

supportedValues.description: Required when cssDataType includes "keyword" (PPG004 if missing); an error to declare otherwise (PPG009 warns).

keywordComparison.description: How supportedValues are compared. Existing CssUtils helpers disagree on this per property (e.g. 'auto' is checked case-insensitively for lengths but not for most other keywords) — encode the real current behavior per entry rather than picking one comparison for everything.

aliasOf.description: Names a legacy alias's target (e.g. page-break-after -> break-after). PPG007 requires the target to exist and to declare the identical initialValue.

supportsDataType.description: Optional, stricter grammar used only by the generated Supports_*/SupportsDeclaration (the @supports oracle) - cssDataType keeps gating real cascade dispatch (Validate_*/Set_*) unchanged. Same shape as cssDataType. Needed when a value is genuinely accepted and stored by real dispatch (matching actual CSS semantics: a value list with one unimplemented member - e.g. a transform function, a break-before keyword - is still syntactically valid and its implemented members still apply) but @supports here uses a stricter standard: does PeachPDF's renderer actually honor this specific value (see issue #283), not just does it parse. Omit when Supports_* should simply forward to Validate_* (the common case).

supportsSupportedValues.description: supportedValues override for supportsDataType's own 'keyword' clause, when it needs a narrower list than the base entry's supportedValues (e.g. break-before's Supports_* excludes region/avoid-region, which parse and are stored but are inert - no FragmentationContext.Region exists). Falls back to the base supportedValues when supportsDataType uses 'keyword' but this is omitted.

supportsKeywordComparison.description: keywordComparison override for supportsDataType's own 'keyword' clause. Falls back to the base keywordComparison when omitted.

resolvesTo.description: Logical-category only (PPG014 otherwise); descriptive metadata the generator surfaces as CssPropertyRegistry.LogicalProperties for a completeness test against CssBox.ResolveLogicalProperties — the resolution algorithm itself stays hand-written.

oneOf.description: 'cssom' means 'no dedicated grammar modeled here' — HTML validation delegates to the real CSS-OM property for the same name (PropertyFactory + StylesheetParser), so it still only accepts what that property's own grammar accepts. Unless a property genuinely accepts unconstrained text, prefer a specific data type (keyword/length/integer/...) over 'cssom' so the accepted grammar is visible in this file rather than only in the CSS-OM.

Delegates validation+conversion to an existing shared converter (e.g. GridTemplateValueConverter.FromCssText) instead of re-deriving grammar this codebase already parses elsewhere — see CLAUDE.md's 'one parser' rule.

typedValueType.description: For a property that also needs a typed (IPropertyValue) fast path, e.g. grid-template-columns.

oneOf.description: A CssProperty<T>-backed property (direction, writing-mode, unicode-bidi, ...). Validation checks the value against keywordMap's own keys; only a recognized keyword passes. CssProperty<T>.FromCssText itself never rejects a value that reaches the setter — it falls back to the given keyword instead of leaving the value unset — but that fallback only runs once validation has already accepted the value.

A CssProperty<CssKeywordOrValue<TEnum,TValue>>-backed property for a '<value> | keyword' grammar (z-index's <integer> | auto, column-width's <length> | auto, ...) that can't use plain 'keyword' or 'enum-keyword' since it isn't keyword-only. Validation checks keywordMap's own keys (case-insensitive, like enum-keyword) OR the valueType grammar; no separate supportedValues/keywordComparison needed. CssKeywordOrValueParser.FromCssText mirrors CssProperty<T>.FromCssText's fallback behavior.

valueType.description: The non-keyword side's grammar and TValue — must match a TryParse-shaped parser (int.TryParse, Length.TryParse, CssValueParser.TryParseLengthOrUnitless) RegistryEmitter knows how to call.

min.description: Narrows an "integer" valueType's validation clause — same field/meaning as the plain "integer" DataTypeKind's own "min" (e.g. column-count's <integer> must be >= 1) — see KeywordOrValueGrammar.

max.description: Narrows an "integer" valueType's validation clause — same field/meaning as the plain "integer" DataTypeKind's own "max" — see KeywordOrValueGrammar.

propertyPath.description: Simple member name on CssBox (or the logical scratch-property name). Null only for an unsupported entry with no storage. PPG011 checks this against CssBox's real shape.

area.description: The ComputedStyleAreas record this property lives in (e.g. "BorderArea"), or null for a logical/unsupported entry. PPG012 checks this against the known area list.

getterExpression.description: Raw C# when the getter isn't a bare field read, e.g. "{box}.Direction.ToString()".

customValidator.description: Raw C# boolean expression, overriding the data-type-driven validator entirely.

customSetter.description: Raw C# statements, spliced in after validation already passed (PPG008 forbids `return` — success is implicit). Tokens: {value}, {box}, {parser}.

snapshot.description: Defaults to hasGetter. Whether this property participates in cascade snapshot/revert (CssPropertyRegistry.SnapshotPropertyNames).

propertyPath.description: Simple member name on SvgElement, or null for a carrier-only property never stored on SvgElement (e.g. direction). PPG010 checks this against SvgElement's real shape.

inheritedFrom.description: The SvgInheritedPaint member carrying this property's inherited value forward through recursive tree-building.

invalidBehavior.description: What SvgTreeBuilder.ApplyCommon does for an invalid value — this genuinely differs per property today (encode the real behavior; don't normalize to one choice).

applyIn.description: "manual" properties (clip-path, mask, marker*, direction) are excluded from the generated dispatch entirely and stay hand-written in ApplyCommon.
